messages:
anya: Sales just pushed back: Beta partner wants a short mini-canary that includes low-latency chat and tenant isolation for their 2-week trial starting 2026-07-12. Theyre willing to accept reduced analytics.
 tom: timeline is tight. our v1 plan bundles chat perf work + tenant routing + observability. we can either split the launch (mini-canary for partner, full v1 later) or postpone the partner trial.
 rachel: engineering capacity looks like: 2wk for tenant isolation + 1wk for perf tweaks + 1wk QA if we deprioritize some infra telemetry. If we compress, QA risk increases.
 kevin: ops note: tenant isolation needs a routing flag + per-tenant config isolation in the config service. we can ship a gated feature with manual onboarding to avoid UI work.
 anya: proposal: do a partner mini-canary (7/127/26) that includes: chat perf tweaks, manual tenant isolation onboarding, and minimal alerts. Defer full dashboarding, embeddings cache tuning, and usage quotas UI to v1 (target Aug). OK?
 tom: whats the visibility loss to support/product if we defer dashboards?
 rachel: we keep critical traces, 5xx alerts, and a simple per-tenant error-rate slack webhook. Drop deep session funnel and cost-by-route until v1.
 kevin: will add an emergency bulk-fallback toggle to ops so we can flip partner to a safe-model variant instantly. I'll run a tabletop during deployment.
 anya: risk controls: 1) limit partner traffic to 2k reqs/day initially, 2) daily health check calls with partner PM, 3) rollback SLA in pilot terms: 4hr remediation for critical regressions.
 tom: approve the mini-canary if we commit to a clear rollback plan and have security signoff on tenant separation.
 rachel: security check: tenant data zoning is straightforward; will need an audit entry for the mini-canary and confirm encryption-at-rest for isolated volumes. I'll post the checklist.
 kevin: deploy-bot: scheduled pipeline "mini-canary/partner-x/manual-onboard" for 2026-07-10 22:00 UTC. status: pending.
 anya: action items: rachel  security checklist + audit entry (due 7/8); kevin  emergency toggle + tabletop (due 7/9); tom  update roadmap & customer note (due 7/8); anya  draft pilot T&Cs + rate limit (due 7/9).
 tom: ack. i'll also flag dependencies in the roadmap tracker and mark the deferred items for v1.
 rachel: ack. will prod a minimal telemetry spec to ensure we don't blind ourselves.
 kevin: ack. will schedule the tabletop and test toggle under simulated load.
 anya: thanks team. if no blockers by Friday, i'll confirm the partner and send onboarding docs. :shipit:
